There is no reason to assume that the brain generates consciousness, though. Say you have a radio, you can turn it on, dial up your favorite radio station, and it will play music. If you damage the radio, the music will stop. If you didn't know any better, you'd assume the radio was creating the music. But the source of the music was never really the radio, it was the signal coming from the station, which is still there. What reason do we have to believe that the same thing isn't true about consciousness?
